title: Foley
description: Foley is the art of creating sound effects for film. This was an exercise in using Ableton's instrumentation to synthesize sounds from the world around us, built entirely in Operator using FM and noise techniques. The practical upside is having a way to recreate field recordings without actually going outside. Useful when I'm feeling lazy, dealing with allergies, or thinking of another excuse.

audio.label: Summer Evening
audio.desc: Crickets, cicadas, and frogs doing their thing while a bottle rocket goes up in the distance.

audio.label: Thunderstorm
audio.desc: Heavy sheets of rain, individual droplets, and rolling thunder.
